scenes.vo: Last night I rewound the tapes. The stranger was never there. Only the tall thing was.
At five A.M., I called my boss. I asked who worked nights before me. He went quiet for a long time.
Then he said, in ninety eight, a night cashier vanished. Mid shift. His locker is still in the back. Nobody ever OPENED it.
The lock was rusted. I broke it with a tire iron. Inside, there was dust, an old jacket, and a plastic BADGE.
Route 9 staff. Walt. Night shift, nineteen ninety eight. The photo was faded, so I wiped it with my thumb.
The pale skin. The tired eyes. I knew that face. The photo on the badge… was the man.
